landing.hero_subtitle: Stop fighting with context limits and hallucinating models. Securely isolate tenant data, deploy agentic pipelines, and monitor real-time AI usage with our unified B2B platform.
landing.features_title: Built for scale, designed for security.
landing.features_subtitle: Everything you need to launch enterprise AI assistants.
landing.feat_1_desc: Cryptographically separate vector spaces for every client. Zero cross-contamination.
landing.feat_2_desc: Semantic routers dynamically select the best LLM and embedding pipeline per query.
landing.feat_3_desc: Granular permissions for Super Admins, Tenant Admins, and standard end-users.
landing.feat_4_desc: Real-time telemetry and monitoring for LLM token usage and response latency.
landing.faq_1_a: We use dedicated Qdrant collections and strict row-level security in PostgreSQL to ensure tenant data is physically and logically separated.
landing.faq_2_q: Can I bring my own LLM?
landing.faq_2_a: Yes. Enterprise plans support custom endpoint routing to your own private OpenAI, Anthropic, or local open-source models.
landing.faq_3_a: Instead of a simple vector search, our agents use tool-calling to re-rank, summarize, and cross-reference multiple documents before answering.
landing.cta_subtitle: Deploy a demo workspace instantly. See how our evaluator agents secure your conversational AI pipelines.
landing.features_main_title: Built for Every Layer of Chatbot QA
landing.f1_d: Create chatbot test projects, manage environments, and scope variables with bulk creation support.
landing.f2_d: Inject reusable test data and run scenarios across a pre-built or custom persona library for targeted chatbot evaluation.
landing.f3_d: Define evidence-based pass/fail rules per chatbot scenario with High/Medium/Low confidence tracking.
landing.f4_d: Execute via isolated tenants with optional secure tunnels for firewall-restricted chatbot endpoints.
landing.f5_d: Automate chatbot test runs using preset frequencies or full custom cron expressions with IANA timezone support.
landing.f6_d: Monitor chatbot performance across test runs with unified dashboards, exportable reports, and real-time quality trends.
landing.faq_a1: Hanka is a secure, multi-tenant AI platform that allows your enterprise to query internal documents securely without data leakage.
landing.faq_q2: How does automated hallucination detection work?
landing.faq_a2: Our proprietary pipeline cross-references multiple chunk sources in real-time, enforcing strict semantic boundaries to prevent fabricated answers.
landing.faq_q3: What metrics are measured in the Dashboard?
landing.faq_a3: We track search time reduction, query volume, cache hit rates, and user engagement metrics across all your organizational tenants.
landing.faq_a4: Yes, our agentic framework allows for continuous evaluation of document retrieval accuracy against baseline datasets.
landing.alert_demo_not_ready: Demo account not ready. Please make sure backend is seeded.
landing.modal_desc: Execute RAG tests in parallel across massive document sets with a reliable isolated infrastructure.
